findings_qualitative.value: 12CO and 13CO velocity fields show twisted and bent iso-velocity curves in the inner disc (<~0.5")

findings_qualitative.value: Symmetric minor-axis dips are mostly due to beam dilution; the SE dip is deeper, possibly extra shadowing

findings_qualitative.value: Warp and emission surface fits did not converge

claims.hypothesis: Does the CQ Tau gas disc show non-Keplerian substructure?
claims.experiment: Centroid velocity maps and razor-thin Keplerian fits with eddy
claims.result: Bent, twisted isovelocities and spiral residuals at 40-180 au

evidence.quote: The gas kinematics of the CQ Tau disc present non-Keplerian features, showing bent and twisted iso-velocity curves in $^{12}$CO and $^{13}$CO.

claims.hypothesis: Are there spirals in 12CO brightness temperature and velocity?
claims.experiment: Subtract azimuthally symmetric models and parameterize residuals
claims.result: Three spirals: two in TB, one in velocity, spanning large azimuth and radius

evidence.quote: We identify three spirals, two in the brightness temperature and one in the velocity residuals, spanning a large azimuth and radial extent.

claims.hypothesis: Are the TB spirals linked to NIR spirals?
claims.experiment: Overlay NIR spiral from Uyama2019 on TB residuals
claims.result: NIR spiral matches the anchoring point of the TB spirals

evidence.quote: The brightness temperature spirals are morphologically connected to spirals observed in NIR scattered light in the same disc, indicating a common origin.

claims.experiment: Pitch angles and number of arms compared with expectations
claims.result: Loosely wound, few arms, large pitch angles
claims.finding: Supports a massive embedded companion over gravitational instability, though GI is not ruled out

evidence.quote: thus gravitational instability cannot be ruled out at this point.

why_this_method.value: Centroid fitting via bettermoments is more robust to noise and gives precision better than channel width

evidence.quote: Compared to other methods this approach is more robust to noise or errors in the line shape, allowing a precision that is greater than the velocity resolution.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Warped disc and emission-surface models attempted but did not converge

evidence.quote: We still attempted to fit for the emission surface, however none of the fits converged.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Convolving channel maps before collapsing was not done as it needs more model assumptions

evidence.quote: Generating channels maps, as opposed to a simple rotation map, however requires far more model assumptions which is why we choose not to do it.

limitations_admitted.value: Posterior uncertainties are small and likely underestimated; systematic model uncertainties

evidence.quote: show very small and likely underestimated uncertainties, especially in context of the scatter that is found in the stellar mass.

limitations_admitted.value: Pitch angles are only rough estimates from by-eye spiral parameterization

evidence.quote: the pitch angles are only a rough estimate, since no actual fit was performed

referee_caveats_inferred: Spirals have low SNR (2-6) and rely on by-eye parameterization
Axisymmetric model subtraction may leave residuals from imperfect geometry or beam smearing
Fixed inclination from earlier work may bias residuals
Moment/centroid fit on a single-peak assumption in a perturbed, possibly unresolved inner disc
